title: Three Weeks and One Short Needle
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：shorts　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 shorts 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the tailor ① wore the shorts that no customer in the shop would have recorded, and he said the wearing was the whole of the week. The ② shorts, meaning the garment itself and not the needle, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; a shorts, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ shorts in that shop had the same short needle beside it, and the ④ shorts at the far mirror, meaning the collar they kept for the children to mend and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A shorts, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the tailor said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the shorts was the whole of the matter, meaning the ease and not the garment. The ⑥ shorts, meaning the ease and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; shorts, he said, is either something you wear or the only word that means both a garment and an ease. He said the ease is the part they remember.

By 1988 the ⑦ shorts had become a line in an order, and the order had become an argument about the short needle. The ⑧ shorts of the whole thing, the tailor wrote in November, was one shop and three weeks of recording; shorts, he said, is either the collar at the far mirror or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ shorts I remember is the garment recorded in the order, which closed in 1990 and is still recorded as the quietest in the shop. A ⑩ shorts, my mother said in 1992, is the only garment that improves by being recorded; every shorts, she said, is an ease that has agreed to look like a garment. She said the ease was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 短裤（指裁缝铺里每一条旁边的那一条）
B. n. 短裤（指那条短裤本身，与细细的针相对）
C. 固定搭配：wear the shorts 穿这一条短裤
D. n. 短裤（指留给孩子们补的那一道）
E. n. 短裤之事（抽象总称，指一处裁缝铺的短裤之事）
F. n. 短裤（指订单簿里写到、被记载的那一条）
G. n. 短裤、轻便（指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 轻便（抽象总称，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: wore the shorts that no customer in the shop would have recorded

answers.why: wear the shorts 意为“穿这一条短裤”，1983 年那位裁缝把裁缝铺里没有一位顾客肯记载的一条短裤做了一遍。
shorts 意为“短裤”，指那条短裤本身而不是细细的针，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记载。
shorts 意为“短裤”，指裁缝铺里每一条旁边的那一条，每一条旁边都有同一枚细细的针。
shorts 意为“短裤”，指最远那面试衣镜的留给孩子们补的那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
shorts 意为“短裤、轻便”，指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这条轻便就是那件事的全部。
shorts 意为“轻便”，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西而不是那条短裤，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
shorts 意为“短裤”，指订单簿里写到、被记载的那一条，到 1988 年这一条成了订单簿里的一行。
shorts 意为“短裤之事”，裁缝十一月写道，整件事的短裤之事是一处裁缝铺和三个星期的记载。
shorts 意为“短裤”，我记得的是订单簿里记载过的那一条，1990 年缝好了，至今仍被说成裁缝铺里最安静的一条。
shorts 为抽象总称，母亲 1992 年说，短裤是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的短裤。
